prompt_md: Some months have 31 days and some have 30. How many months have 28 days?
prompt_short: Some months have 31 days and some have 30. How many months have 28 days?
hint_md: Having 28 days is not the same as having exactly 28 days.
explain_intuition_md: February jumps to mind because it is the short one, but every month gets at least as far as day 28.
explain_math_md: Every month has at least 28 days, so the count is $12$.
